The program computes: for each window of k=501 consecutive values (values from value-k+1 to value), it finds min position and max position among those values (using monotonic deques over values, keyed by position), and computes max position - min position, taking the minimum over all windows.

So essentially: for each set of k consecutive values [l, l+500], compute max_{v in [l,l+500]} position[v] - min_{v in [l,l+500]} position[v]. Answer = min over l=1..502.
